_doc: Which method built each GPCRdb model the database uses (build 2024-05-15). GPCRdb labels every model AlphaFold2-Multistate (Heo and Feig, Proteins 2022, doi 10.1002/prot.26382) or plain AlphaFold2 (Jumper et al., Nature 2021, doi 10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2): it first ran standard AlphaFold2 with all templates, classified the best model as active or inactive, and built the missing state with AlphaFold-Multistate on state-filtered templates (Herrera et al., NAR 2025, doi 10.1093/nar/gkae1065). Read by website/model_methods.py. null = no method recorded (MCHR1 is missing from GPCRdb's current model list).
